name: Event Horizon
interact: () => { const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); let x = 400; const id = setInterval(() => { x += 7; c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', {clientX: x, clientY: 300, bubbles: true})); }, 16); setTimeout(() => clearInterval(id), 8000); }

name: Lift Logic
interact: () => { const algos = ['nearest','scan','fcfs','zoned']; let i = 0; const id = setInterval(() => window.__bench.setAlgo(algos[i++ % 4]), 4000); setTimeout(() => clearInterval(id), 16000); }
